note: Re-quoted to the Open Word Bible, Balanced edition (owb-ja, CC0), per the founder decision that Japanese quotes OWB for every work (2026-11-19); it replaces the 口語訳 (japkougo) wording the translation first shipped with.

A `mined` row is a quotation (cited, uncited, or a verbatim recitation without marks) whose words are exact OWB, checked against the bundled text: a span of the verse, or pieces of it joined with '…'. block_index counts per chapter (chapter_order).
A `self_rendered` row is an allusion, a narrative reference or the author's own paraphrase of the verse, which stays the translator's wording.
